### Why DO NOT SHIP
Two of the four sections (Form and Checkout) have confirmed, reproducible correctness bugs in their core logic — not edge cases, but the primary happy path (select a tier and submit; adjust quantity and check the total). Combined with a layout bug that can eject users from the app unexpectedly, this build should not go out as-is. Recommend fixing #1 and #2 (logic bugs), and #3 (inset/padding) before the next candidate; #4–#6 can be follow-ups.'
